description: A Dart/Flutter client for planning trips, fetching stop departures, and looking up individual trips over the Spider transit API.
rules: Construct one client with your environment base URL and API key, then reach a surface: SpiderClient('https://your-env-slug.api.tiducto.eu', apiKey).routing / .stops / .realtime.
Plan a trip with client.routing.plan(PlanOptions(origin, destination, first)); get stop departures with client.routing.departures(stopId) and a single trip with client.routing.trip(tripId).
Search or geo-query stops through client.stops, and poll live vehicle positions, delays, and alerts through client.realtime.
Every call returns a SpiderResult<T> you branch on (Success / Failure); the only thrown error is SpiderContractMismatchError, raised on a major contract-version mismatch.
